name: SparrKULee: A Speech-Evoked Auditory Response Repository from KU Leuven, Containing the EEG of 85 Participants
readme:
[![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.82901%2Fnemar.nm000238-blue)](https://doi.org/10.82901/nemar.nm000238)
=============================================================
IMPORTANT — RESTRICTED SUBJECTS EXCLUDED FROM NEMAR RE-HOST
=============================================================
IMPORTANT — 5 of the 85 original subjects (sub-019, sub-020, sub-021, sub-022, sub-026) are EXCLUDED from this NEMAR re-host because their raw EEG files are access-restricted on the KU Leuven Dataverse (HTTP 403 on download without a data-use agreement). Researchers who need these subjects should email sparrkulee@kuleuven.be to request access and download the data directly from https://rdr.kuleuven.be/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=doi:10.48804/K3VSND (DOI 10.48804/K3VSND). The re-host therefore contains 80 of the original 85 subjects, covering all 11 session types (shortstories01, varyingStories01..10).
Excluded subjects: sub-019, sub-020, sub-021, sub-022, sub-026
Cohort demographics
-------------------
Cohort demographics (from Accou et al., Data 2024, 9, 94, Section 2.1): 85 original participants, 74 female / 11 male, aged 21.4 ± 1.9 years (mean ± SD), inclusion window 18-30 years, all normal-hearing (≤30 dB HL, 125-8000 Hz), native Dutch/Flemish speakers. Per-subject numeric ages are not published by the SparrKULee authors for privacy reasons; `participants.tsv` only ships 3-year binned ages in the `age_range` column (see `participants.json` for details).
How to cite
-----------
Please cite the original SparrKULee data descriptor when using this dataset: Accou, B., Bollens, L., Gillis, M., Verheijen, W., Van hamme, H., & Francart, T. (2024). SparrKULee: A Speech-Evoked Auditory Response Repository from KU Leuven, Containing the EEG of 85 Participants. Data, 9(8), 94. https://doi.org/10.3390/data9080094
Where extra metadata lives (after NEMAR preparation)
----------------------------------------------------
  * `/task-listeningActive_eeg.json` — full recording-level EEG metadata (SamplingFrequency, Manufacturer, EEGChannelCount, EEGReference, PowerLineFrequency, ...). Version 1.0.0 kept it under `/code/` because the EEG was stored as `.bdf.gz`, which the validator does not match against the sidecar. Since version 1.1.0 the EEG is plain `.bdf` and the sidecar is back at the dataset root, where BIDS inheritance applies it to every `task-listeningActive` recording.
  * `/task-restingState_eeg.json` — added in version 1.1.0 (the validator requires it once the restingState `.bdf` files are visible): TaskName and SamplingFrequency from the BDF headers; EEGReference, PowerLineFrequency and SoftwareFilters copied from the authors' `task-listeningActive_eeg.json` (same BioSemi ActiveTwo set-up).
  * `/sourcedata/` — added in version 1.1.0: the 659 original `*_eeg.bdf.gz` files of the KU Leuven RDR release (doi:10.48804/K3VSND), byte-identical, at their original relative paths (`sourcedata/sub-XXX/ses-YYY/eeg/...`). They are the files version 1.0.0 stored as EEG data. `sourcedata/sourcedata_provenance.json` lists size, SHA-256, MD5 and RDR file id of each. BIDS tools ignore `sourcedata/`.
  * `sub-*/ses-*/eeg/*_channels.tsv` (task listeningActive, restingState) — added in version 1.1.0, one per recording: channel name, type, units, sampling frequency and filter cut-offs read from that recording's BDF header.
  * `/task-listeningActive_eeg.json` — in version 1.1.0 `TaskName` changed from `listening` to `listeningActive` to match the file names; `SamplingFrequency` 8192 → 1024 to match the BDF headers; every other value is the authors'.
  * No `electrodes.tsv` / `coordsystem.json`: the release has no digitised electrode positions, and template positions would be invented.
  * `/code/remarks/` — per-session free-form recording notes (`.txt` and `.docx`) originally placed under `sub-XX/ses-YY/remarks/`. Relocated so the validator does not see an arbitrary `remarks/` folder inside BIDS session directories.
  * `/code/convert_accou2023.py` — the exact script that was run to produce this NEMAR re-host.

README
======
__SparrKULee__: A Speech-evoked Auditory Response Repository of the KU Leuven, containing EEG of 85 participants
Overview
--------
An overview of the dataset including details about the filetypes, methods and technical validation can be found in [our
paper]()
Notes
-----
Code to download, preprocess and validate the data can be found at https://github.com/exporl/auditory-eeg-dataset.
Due to mistakes during recording, following recordings do not have an adequate number of triggers and can therefore not be accurately aligned with the stimulus:
1. sub-006/ses-shortstories01/eeg/sub-006_ses-shortstories01_task-listeningActive_run-06_eeg.bdf
2. sub-017/ses-shortstories01/eeg/sub-017_ses-shortstories01_task-listeningActive_run-03_eeg.bdf
3. sub-048/ses-varyingStories05/eeg/sub-048_ses-varyingStories05_task-listeningActive_run-04_eeg.bdf

generated_by.Description: Prepared the original SparrKULee BIDS dataset for NEMAR re-hosting: excluded 5 access-restricted subjects (sub-019..022, sub-026), moved the string-range `age` column into `age_range` and set `age` to n/a, moved per-session `remarks/` text files into `/code/remarks/`, moved orphan top-level EEG sidecar into `/code/` (the raw EEG ships as `.bdf.gz` which the validator does not recognise as a BIDS data suffix), filled in recommended task-level metadata (TaskName/Description/Instructions/Institution*/StimulusPresentation) on the top-level `_beh.json` and `_events.json` sidecars, and added a prominent exclusion warning plus cohort demographics to README and dataset_description.json.

generated_by.Name: nm000238 v1.1.0 plain-BDF rebuild
generated_by.Description: Decompressed every sub-*/ses-*/eeg/*_eeg.bdf.gz of version 1.0.0 to *_eeg.bdf: the SHA-256 of each .bdf.gz was checked against its git-annex key, gzip checked CRC32 and length, and every BDF header was checked (BIOSEMI magic, 24BIT, header size, file size = header + records x samples x 3 bytes). Signal and header bytes are unchanged. Moved task-listeningActive_eeg.json from /code/ back to the dataset root and removed *.bdf.gz from .bidsignore. Scripts and the per-file verification table are in /code/plain_bdf_v1.1.0/.
